name: Rosewood Guangzhou
positioning: Rosewood city hotel in Guangzhou that blends modern design with Southern Chinese heritage, with city and Pearl River views from its rooms
best_for: Food-focused travelers who want Cantonese dim sum, Japanese teppanyaki and a whisky bar under one roof
Travelers who want city skyline or Pearl River views from their room

facts.text: Lingnan House is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, serving dim sum and Cantonese classics.
Patina European Brasserie & Terrace is a seafood brasserie with a touch of European charm.
Black Iron serves contemporary Japanese cuisine specialising in sukiyaki, sashimi and teppanyaki.
Brick Lane is an outdoor bar with a modern brewery, a cocktail and wine bar, and live music.
The Butterfly Room is the lobby lounge, serving afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.
Butterfly Patisserie offers French pastries, chocolates and confections.
Canton Tower View Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling city views.
Manor Suites are residential-style suites overlooking the Guangzhou cityscape, with executive lounge access.
The hotel blends modern design with Southern Chinese heritage.
Asaya Active offers Augustinus Bader body and facial treatments.
A Curated Guangzhou Journey takes guests to the city's cultural landmarks.
Guests can design their own Bloom Bucket in a flower workshop with the hotel's in-house florist.

highlights.text: Lingnan House is listed in the Michelin Guide Guangzhou for 2020 to 2026.
Too High is a bar offering 107 hand-picked single malts, along with rare rums, smoky mezcal and hard-to-find Cognacs.
Xi Guan House is a duplex corner suite with wrap-around views.
Deluxe River Rooms have views of the Pearl River and a king bed.
The Old to New Cycling Discovery traces the evolution of Guangzhou by bike.

considerations.text: Too High and Brick Lane are both outdoor bars.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may feel less cultural for leisure travelers.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
